10523.overview: In order to stop another Ice Age from occurring, Vail the Avenger must make a trek across the frozen lands in order to reach the Ice Palace of Kalktron the Terrible and put a stop to his evil plans to freeze the land. He will have to ski through a herd of Caribou, cross the frozen river, and then take on the many dangers of the Ice Palace in order to stop Kalktron. Can he stop another Ice Age?

111718.overview: The enchanted mirror splits you into multiple images. You must become whole before time runs out. Changing stairways and folding cubes with SuperGraphics try to keep you from safety.

217942.overview:
Istar is a puzzle game, where it is the goal to collect all the rings.
You can only move from wall to wall and along walls and only stop by hitting a wall.
Sometimes the gold block will help out, but sometimes it is "imprisoned" and can NOT be moved.
There is also an editor for creating own levels.

420511.overview: Try to guess the INTLE in six attempts or less! Each guess must be a valid five letter word. After each guess, the color of the tiles will change to show how close your guess is to the word. Stumped? Hit the tip button and receive one letter as a tip. But use this option sparingly, as you'll receive only one tip per game! Based on WORDLE by Josh Wardle, INTLE includes over 5,000 words.

459636.overview: Intellivania (stylized IntelliVania) is an action-adventure platformer video game developed by Matthew Kiehl for the Intellivision. It is a demake of Castlevania for the Nintendo Entertainment System. It was first released as part of the Intellivision Revolution project in 2020, and later sold separately in digital ROM format.
